newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank raises other repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank raises other repo rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Friday lifted its borrowing rates on the rest of its reverse repo (rrp) instruments following the 25 basis point increase in its overnight borrowing rate to 10.25 percent.
The rate on the five-day rrp was raised to 10.25 from 10.0 percent.
The rate on the one-month rrp is now at 10.3125 from 10.125 percent; the two-month rrp, 10.375 from 10.1875; and the six-month rrp, 10.625 from 10.5625.
